description: This file contains utility functions for RFC management, including system event polling, RFC property reading via rbus or WDMP, command execution, string manipulation, and reading scheduling configurations from files.

methods.name: getSyseventValue
methods.description: Executes a system command to retrieve the value of a system event key.

methods.name: waitForRfcCompletion
methods.description: Polls the system to wait until RFC blob processing is completed or times out.

methods.name: read_RFCProperty
methods.description: Reads an RFC property value via rbus or WDMP, handling different data types.

methods.name: executeCommandAndGetOutput
methods.description: Executes a system command and captures its output into a string.

methods.name: CheckSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any non-alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: StringCaseCompare
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: RemoveSubstring
methods.description: Removes all instances of a substring from a string.

methods.name: getCronFromDCMSettings
methods.description: Reads and returns the cron schedule from DCMSettings configuration files.
